_doc: DB10: round-trip ceiling per route the web client calls. trips = X-DB-Trips, wire = statements sent. Lower it when a route gets cheaper (node tests/round-trips-all.test.cjs --write); never raise without saying why. fired:false = placeholder ceiling, the route could not be fired offline (see why).
